title: The Missing Initial
prompt: What letter comes next in this sequence?
J, F, M, A, M, J, J, A, S, O, N, ?
hints: The sequence has 12 terms once completed. Does that suggest a familiar system?
Each letter is the initial of something that repeats every year.
solution_lede: Each letter is the first letter of a month of the year, in order: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November — and the missing one is December.

solution_steps.body: J=January, F=February, M=March, A=April, M=May, J=June, J=July, A=August, S=September, O=October, N=November.
The next and final month is December. Its initial is D.
